These four unmodified report files come from the locally executed Vivado 2020.2 Ethernet CDC implementation at `artifacts/hard-ethernet-cdc-impl-20261022T184242Z-8aa581/`. They freeze actual report formats for parsing regression: 34 CDC warnings, one unconstrained input port, 1,896 physical Slice LUTs and 4,590 fully routed nets. Their historical result is not a new implementation run.
